description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractJDBCDao' that provides database connection setup logic for JDBC-based database access, including loading the MySQL driver and establishing connections using specified configuration parameters.

classes.name: AbstractJDBCDao
classes.description: An abstract class providing JDBC connection setup and management functionalities for subclasses.

methods.name: setupDBDriver
methods.description: Loads the MySQL JDBC driver class to enable database connectivity.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a new JDBC connection to the database using configured parameters.
